translations.en.sahih: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]
translations.en.pickthall: When the sun is overthrown,
translations.en.yusufali: When the sun (with its spacious light) is folded up;
translations.id.indonesian: Apabila matahari digulung,

translations.en.sahih: And when the stars fall, dispersing,
translations.en.pickthall: And when the stars fall,
translations.en.yusufali: When the stars fall, losing their lustre;
translations.id.indonesian: dan apabila bintang-bintang berjatuhan,

translations.en.sahih: And when the mountains are removed
translations.en.pickthall: And when the hills are moved,
translations.en.yusufali: When the mountains vanish (like a mirage);
translations.id.indonesian: dan apabila gunung-gunung dihancurkan,

translations.en.sahih: And when full-term she-camels are neglected
translations.en.pickthall: And when the camels big with young are abandoned,
translations.en.yusufali: When the she-camels, ten months with young, are left untended;
translations.id.indonesian: dan apabila unta-unta yang bunting ditinggalkan (tidak diperdulikan)

translations.en.sahih: And when the wild beasts are gathered
translations.en.pickthall: And when the wild beasts are herded together,
translations.en.yusufali: When the wild beasts are herded together (in the human habitations);
translations.id.indonesian: dan apabila binatang-binatang liar dikumpulkan,

translations.en.sahih: And when the seas are filled with flame
translations.en.pickthall: And when the seas rise,
translations.en.yusufali: When the oceans boil over with a swell;
translations.id.indonesian: dan apabila lautan dijadikan meluap

translations.en.sahih: And when the souls are paired
translations.en.pickthall: And when souls are reunited,
translations.en.yusufali: When the souls are sorted out, (being joined, like with like);
translations.id.indonesian: dan apabila ruh-ruh dipertemukan (dengan tubuh)

translations.en.sahih: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked
translations.en.pickthall: And when the girl-child that was buried alive is asked
translations.en.yusufali: When the female (infant), buried alive, is questioned -
translations.id.indonesian: dan apabila bayi-bayi perempuan yang dikubur hidup-hidup ditanya,

translations.en.sahih: For what sin she was killed
translations.en.pickthall: For what sin she was slain,
translations.en.yusufali: For what crime she was killed;
translations.id.indonesian: karena dosa apakah dia dibunuh,

translations.en.sahih: And when the pages are made public
translations.en.pickthall: And when the pages are laid open,
translations.en.yusufali: When the scrolls are laid open;
translations.id.indonesian: dan apabila catatan-catatan (amal perbuatan manusia) dibuka,

translations.en.sahih: And when the sky is stripped away
translations.en.pickthall: And when the sky is torn away,
translations.en.yusufali: When the world on High is unveiled;
translations.id.indonesian: dan apabila langit dilenyapkan,

translations.en.sahih: And when Hellfire is set ablaze
translations.en.pickthall: And when hell is lighted,
translations.en.yusufali: When the Blazing Fire is kindled to fierce heat;
translations.id.indonesian: dan apabila neraka Jahim dinyalakan,

translations.en.sahih: And when Paradise is brought near,
translations.en.pickthall: And when the Garden is brought nigh,
translations.en.yusufali: And when the Garden is brought near;-
translations.id.indonesian: dan apabila surga didekatkan,

translations.en.sahih: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].
translations.en.pickthall: (Then) every soul will know what it hath made ready.
translations.en.yusufali: (Then) shall each soul know what it has put forward.
translations.id.indonesian: maka tiap-tiap jiwa akan mengetahui apa yang telah dikerjakannya.

translations.en.sahih: So I swear by the retreating stars -
translations.en.pickthall: Oh, but I call to witness the planets,
translations.en.yusufali: So verily I call to witness the planets - that recede,
translations.id.indonesian: Sungguh, Aku bersumpah dengan bintang-bintang,

translations.en.sahih: Those that run [their courses] and disappear -
translations.en.pickthall: The stars which rise and set,
translations.en.yusufali: Go straight, or hide;
translations.id.indonesian: yang beredar dan terbenam,

translations.en.sahih: And by the night as it closes in
translations.en.pickthall: And the close of night,
translations.en.yusufali: And the Night as it dissipates;
translations.id.indonesian: demi malam apabila telah hampir meninggalkan gelapnya,

translations.en.sahih: And by the dawn when it breathes
translations.en.pickthall: And the breath of morning
translations.en.yusufali: And the Dawn as it breathes away the darkness;-
translations.id.indonesian: dan demi subuh apabila fajarnya mulai menyingsing,

translations.en.sahih: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger
translations.en.pickthall: That this is in truth the word of an honoured messenger,
translations.en.yusufali: Verily this is the word of a most honourable Messenger,
translations.id.indonesian: sesungguhnya Al Quran itu benar-benar firman (Allah yang dibawa oleh) utusan yang mulia (Jibril),

arabic: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],
translations.en.pickthall: Mighty, established in the presence of the Lord of the Throne,
translations.en.yusufali: Endued with Power, with rank before the Lord of the Throne,
translations.id.indonesian: yang mempunyai kekuatan, yang mempunyai kedudukan tinggi di sisi Allah yang mempunyai 'Arsy,

translations.en.sahih: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.
translations.en.pickthall: (One) to be obeyed, and trustworthy;
translations.en.yusufali: With authority there, (and) faithful to his trust.
translations.id.indonesian: yang ditaati di sana (di alam malaikat) lagi dipercaya.

translations.en.sahih: And your companion is not [at all] mad.
translations.en.pickthall: And your comrade is not mad.
translations.en.yusufali: And (O people!) your companion is not one possessed;
translations.id.indonesian: Dan temanmu (Muhammad) itu bukanlah sekali-kali orang yang gila.

transliteration: Wa laqad ra aahu bilufuqil mubeen

translations.en.sahih: And he has already seen Gabriel in the clear horizon.
translations.en.pickthall: Surely he beheld Him on the clear horizon.
translations.en.yusufali: And without doubt he saw him in the clear horizon.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Muhammad itu melihat Jibril di ufuk yang terang.

translations.en.sahih: And Muhammad is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen.
translations.en.pickthall: And he is not avid of the Unseen.
translations.en.yusufali: Neither doth he withhold grudgingly a knowledge of the Unseen.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan dia (Muhammad) bukanlah orang yang bakhil untuk menerangkan yang ghaib.

transliteration: Wa maa huwa biqawli shaitaanir rajeem

translations.en.sahih: And the Qur'an is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].
translations.en.pickthall: Nor is this the utterance of a devil worthy to be stoned.
translations.en.yusufali: Nor is it the word of an evil spirit accursed.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Al Quran itu bukanlah perkataan syaitan yang terkutuk,

translations.en.sahih: So where are you going?
translations.en.pickthall: Whither then go ye?
translations.en.yusufali: When whither go ye?
translations.id.indonesian: maka ke manakah kamu akan pergi?

translations.en.sahih: It is not except a reminder to the worlds
translations.en.pickthall: This is naught else than a reminder unto creation,
translations.en.yusufali: Verily this is no less than a Message to (all) the Worlds:
translations.id.indonesian: Al Quran itu tiada lain hanyalah peringatan bagi semesta alam,

translations.en.sahih: For whoever wills among you to take a right course.
translations.en.pickthall: Unto whomsoever of you willeth to walk straight.
translations.en.yusufali: (With profit) to whoever among you wills to go straight:
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) bagi siapa di antara kamu yang mau menempuh jalan yang lurus.

arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
transliteration: Wa maa tashaaa'oona illaaa ai yashaaa 'al laahu Rabbul 'Aalameen

translations.en.sahih: And you do not will except that Allah wills - Lord of the worlds.
translations.en.pickthall: And ye will not, unless (it be) that Allah willeth, the Lord of Creation.
translations.en.yusufali: But ye shall not will except as Allah wills,- the Cherisher of the Worlds.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan kamu tidak dapat menghendaki (menempuh jalan itu) kecuali apabila dikehendaki Allah, Tuhan semesta alam.
